what: F1: Plan parses helper error KVs from stderr, but lib-quiet helpers emit contract KVs on stdout
scenario_or_breakage: rebase-push.sh emits REBASE_ERROR with emit_kv on stdout, and append-execution-issue.sh emits FAILED/ERROR on stdout; the proposed wrapper tests stub these failures on stderr, so real non-conflict rebase failures degrade to REBASE_ERROR=unknown and append failures may surface an empty PHANTOM_APPEND_WARN_ERROR
suggested_fix: Update the plan to parse REBASE_ERROR and append ERROR from captured stdout contract lines, optionally falling back to stderr; change wrapper harness stubs to emit real helper-shaped stdout KVs for rc=3 and append-failure cases

what: F2: Plan relies on bare helper names/PATH injection for plugin-owned helper calls
scenario_or_breakage: Bare rebase-push.sh, check-phantom-dirty.sh, or append-execution-issue.sh resolution can be intercepted by caller PATH in consumer repos, while adjacent scripts use SCRIPT_DIR to call sibling helpers
suggested_fix: Invoke plugin-owned helpers via "$SCRIPT_DIR/<helper>.sh"; adapt tests by copying wrappers into a temp script directory with stub sibling helpers or by adding an explicit test hook variable, rather than depending on production PATH lookup

what: F3: Plan omits agent-lint dead-script exclusions for new source-only and Makefile-only files
scenario_or_breakage: make lint includes agent-lint G004; agent-lint does not follow source directives or Makefile-only harness targets, so scripts/lib-phantom-probe.sh and the two new test harnesses can be reported as dead even though the plan requires make lint to pass
suggested_fix: Add agent-lint.toml exclude entries and rationale for scripts/lib-phantom-probe.sh, scripts/test-rebase-checkpoint-probe.sh, and scripts/test-phantom-probe-with-warn.sh, plus any sibling .md exclusions if local convention requires them

what: F4: Direct SKILL.md invocations require executable new wrapper files, but the plan does not call out file modes
scenario_or_breakage: The planned fences invoke "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rebase-checkpoint-probe.sh" and phantom-probe-with-warn.sh directly; if the new files land as 0644, Makefile harnesses that run via bash can pass while /implement fails with permission denied
suggested_fix: Add an implementation step to chmod +x all new .sh files and add a harness assertion that the two runtime wrappers are executable and invoked directly at least once

what: F5: Clean-run transcript call-count acceptance is not validated
scenario_or_breakage: The feature acceptance requires an /implement clean-run transcript showing reduced mid-run Bash calls, but the plan only wires unit/structural harnesses and make lint, so the call-count reduction can land unproven
suggested_fix: Add a validation step that captures or reuses an /implement clean-run transcript and compares the relevant rebase/probe Bash-call count against baseline, or explicitly records a fixture-based transcript check if a live run is too expensive
